checks.summary: 434 tests passed; 39 actual PDFs passed; four fresh SSKR generated files match; six findings (one medium, five low); two informational observations.

findings.title: File-size guards do not bound the actual read
findings.reproduction: Run the public-data probe-input.py harness. It sends 2,097,245 bytes containing a valid public mnemonic followed by spaces through a finite FIFO, and compares a regular file with identical bytes.
findings.expected: The documented 1 MiB text-input limit must apply to bytes actually consumed, including non-regular files and changing files.
findings.observed: The regular file exits 1 with the size-limit error; the FIFO has stat.size=0 and exits 0 with a successfully encoded mnemonic. Both text and PNG readers use stat followed by an unbounded whole-file read; only the text case was exercised.
findings.impact: A user-selected FIFO/device or growing file can consume memory beyond the advertised bound or wait indefinitely. No remote input service, theft, or wrong recovery was demonstrated; the probe used only 2 MiB.
findings.recommendedFix: Open once and read at most limit+1 bytes, rejecting overflow; either reject unsupported non-regular inputs or enforce the same bounded reader on them. Apply the same approach to QR file bytes before decoding.
findings.requiredVerification: Test exactly limit, limit+1, a finite FIFO, file growth and PNG byte limits without intentionally exhausting memory.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

findings.title: Unknown Bitcoin evidence kinds silently become a recovery non-match
findings.reproduction: Call matchBitcoinEvidence with the public abandon/about mnemonic, kind="address-typo", profiles=["native-segwit"], value="irrelevant", and mainnet account/branch/index all zero. The exact executable command is in the Checks table and JSON command evidence.
findings.expected: An unsupported runtime discriminator should be rejected before derivation, rather than reported as a valid comparison that did not match.
findings.observed: The public JavaScript API returns {"matched":false,"kind":"address-typo"}. matchDerivedNode falls through and the outer function emits an ordinary negative result.
findings.impact: An untyped integration or deserialized configuration can mistake a programming error for evidence against the correct wallet. The CLI constructs supported kinds and was not shown vulnerable; valid supported comparisons pass existing tests.
findings.recommendedFix: Validate the evidence kind against the supported set at entry, before reading variant-specific fields; make an unsupported switch branch fail explicitly.
findings.requiredVerification: Unknown/missing discriminators fail with stable non-secret-bearing errors. Retain positive and negative address, key, WIF, xpub and fingerprint cases.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

findings.title: The manual PDF/QR regression script stops before checking any document
findings.reproduction: After pnpm build, run node scripts/check-card-output.mjs docs/audits/AUD-004-evidence/manual-card-output.
findings.expected: The maintained manual export check should use supported options and reach its PDF/QR assertions.
findings.observed: Exit 1: "Error: Page size must be a6, a4 or business." The base fixture uses removed pageSize="wallet". A later CLI case also combines collection layout with business size, which the current API rejects.
findings.impact: The supplemental actual-PDF verification is unusable and the unit-test comment points readers to a broken check. This does not mean exported QR data is wrong: the separate current-API harness passed 39 documents.
findings.recommendedFix: Update all fixtures to the current page/layout contract and put at least one real PDF-to-image-to-QR smoke test in CI.
findings.requiredVerification: Run the entire repaired script through its final assertion, including ordinary sheets, fragments and SSKR exports.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

findings.title: The unconditional atomic-publication promise excludes SSKR file writers
findings.reproduction: Run write-failure.mjs. The audit-only adapter simulates ENOSPC after writing 16 bytes at the final SSKR PDF path; it restores the filesystem adapter and removes its public-data output afterwards.
findings.expected: SECURITY.md promises that a file appears under its final name only after it is complete.
findings.observed: The export rejects the simulated write error, but a 16-byte partial PDF remains at the final path with mode 0600. SSKR PDF and record outputs write directly with wx; ordinary record/PDF exports use private staging.
findings.impact: A failed export can leave an incomplete backup at the requested path, contrary to the blanket documentation promise. The command does report failure and permissions remain private; no successful corrupt backup or unauthorized disclosure is claimed.
findings.recommendedFix: Either implement complete-file publication for SSKR outputs while preserving exclusive no-overwrite behavior, or narrow the promise and document cleanup/retry behavior on partial writes.
findings.requiredVerification: Inject partial writes and cancellation; verify no final partial file under an atomic contract, preserve pre-existing destinations, and keep private permissions.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

findings.title: The documented default size of six- and eight-reference cards is stale
findings.reproduction: Render individual cards using business-glass-6in1 and business-glass-8in1 with pageSize omitted; render-check.mjs measures the PDF media box.
findings.expected: Documentation should describe the dimensions actually generated for separate cards.
findings.observed: README says 85.6 x 54 mm without an explicit page size. Both generated individual cards measure 90 x 50 mm. The code intentionally uses businessShape when individualIndex is present.
findings.impact: Users can choose an unsuitable holder, print layout or cutting dimensions. No encoded reference is lost.
findings.recommendedFix: Describe individual cards as 90 x 50 mm; distinguish the proportions of decorative sheet artwork from physical separate-card dimensions.
findings.requiredVerification: Keep PDF media-box assertions for all three glass capacities with omitted and explicit page sizes.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

findings.title: The SSKR fixture description overstates the Bytewords vector count
findings.expected: The test-data description should distinguish the full UR set from the selected Bytewords quorum.
findings.observed: The file contains eight UR shares and five Bytewords shares; the prose describes all eight in both forms. The five Bytewords entries are a valid quorum and the recovery test passes.
findings.impact: Readers overestimate the breadth of the cross-representation fixture set. This is a documentation defect, not a cryptographic failure.
findings.recommendedFix: State eight UR shares and one five-share Bytewords quorum, or add the remaining independently sourced Bytewords fixtures.
findings.requiredVerification: Check the written counts against the JSON and retain recovery of the published quorum.
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Limited to the stated boundary or documentation; no demonstrated failure of valid mnemonic or SSKR recovery.

observations.title: Numeric CLI format renumbering is an explicit compatibility change
evidence: Pre-existing diff: src/cli/input.ts, src/cli/usage.ts, test/cli.test.ts, CHANGELOG.md; retained locally in AUD-004-evidence/baseline.diff
observations.reproduction: Compare HEAD with the reviewed working tree: numeric 4 changes from unicode to colors-unicode; numeric 6 is removed.
observations.expected: Intentional interface changes are distinguished from accidental functional regressions.
observations.observed: All five named formats still work; format 3 remains unicode. MNC1 records store format names, so the numeric renumbering does not alter their interpretation.
observations.impact: Old scripts using --format 4 change output and --format 6 fail. This is not purely visual. The audit does not infer an accidental defect from an intentional pending change.
observations.recommendedFix: Before adopting the new numbering, confirm that saved commands are migrated; prefer stable named formats in automation. Keep the changelog notice.
observations.requiredVerification: Current CLI format matrix passes; if old numeric commands must remain compatible, define and test an explicit migration policy.

observations.title: Extend automated presentation and platform coverage
observations.reproduction: Inspect the CI workflow and platform-conditional tests.
observations.expected: CI coverage should reflect the supported maintenance and export contracts.
observations.observed: CI runs Linux types/build/tests/dependency audit, but not format:check or the independent actual-PDF audit matrix. This audit executed Linux only.
observations.impact: Formatting, real rasterization and non-Linux regressions can escape the current gates; no additional platform failure was reproduced.
observations.recommendedFix: Add format checking, a small real PDF/QR smoke check, and a supported second-OS test job. Keep resource-intensive matrices separate.
observations.requiredVerification: Observe the added gates on the intended platforms; do not count this Linux audit as Windows/macOS validation.

limitations: Snapshot includes eight pre-existing uncommitted files. User reported concurrent visual work. Tracked files remained byte-identical to the initial captured snapshot before report creation; later changes require re-verification.
Linux x86_64 only. No Windows/macOS execution, actual hidden systemd prompt interaction, browser host application, physical print/scan or assistive-device testing.
The standalone package has no button GUI. Consumers embedding its card renderer are outside this repository audit.
Not every input/font/layout combination or every secret-memory exceptional path was exhausted. No production secrets and no intentional resource exhaustion were used.

Fresh Rust target and all four generated SSKR outputs were verified, using an existing pinned container image. No uncached base/toolchain-image rebuild, fresh pnpm installation, or RustSec advisory scan.

Initial sandbox run: 403 passed, 28 failed, 3 skipped; subprocess EPERM invalidated those CLI failures as product evidence. Unrestricted rerun: 434 passed with zero skips. Initial npm/Docker/network permission failures were kept separately.

First audit render harness failed because pdf-lib load default rewrote metadata. Corrected to updateMetadata:false; the unmodified production output then passed. This was an auditor-harness error, not a product finding.
No independent cryptographic certification, no release approval, no production fix, no commit/push/tag/release.
